_about: A person's reading (Claude, as the reviewer, 2026-11-09; NOT a second independent labeller) of every reply the answering layer gave the 48 questions in questions.json, at the commit where this file was written. C = correct and useful; P = partly correct or useful; N = no answer given (an honest clarifying question, a pointer, or the fixed 'I can turn a pasted procedure into steps' reply); W = wrong or misleading (an answer about the wrong step or the wrong application). Useful rate = (C + 0.5 P) / 48. Re-run `python -m ingestion.eval.qa_suite` after any change and re-read the replies; do not treat this file as current once the code changes.
